title: ArcadiPerformance
description:
Dieses Pack wurde erstellt, um die bestmögliche Performance zu erreichen und trotzdem kosmetische Erweiterungen und zusätzliche, coole QoL-Mods dabei zu haben.

Alle gängigen QoL-Mods sind vorhanden und das bei bester Performance!
body:
This modpack is the perfect choice for anyone looking to experience Minecraft at its best performance without altering the classic gameplay. It combines a variety of optimization and performance mods with practical quality-of-life improvements and graphical enhancements that make Minecraft shine—without any noticeable compromises.

Thanks to the powerful combination of mods like Sodium and many other optimization tools, the game runs smoothly even at high render distances. The Bobby mod allows for generous adjustments to render distance, while shaders deliver stunning graphics without sacrificing performance.

After extensive tweaking and countless experiments, this modpack is the ultimate solution for anyone wanting to enjoy Minecraft in breathtaking quality and with a stutter-free experience. Discover how fantastic Minecraft can look and feel—without any trade-offs!


This pack includes the following shaderpacks:

https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined
